title: Continuous sample paths give continuous marginal laws
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement. Pass almost-sure time convergence to weak convergence of the same pushforward laws.
target_statement: Let $\rho_t$ be the pushforward law of the random state at time $t$. Almost-sure continuity of whole sample paths implies continuity of the map from time to marginal law in the topology of integration against bounded continuous tests.
